newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -BTPs must clear 136.00, or 135.00 beckons.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -BTPs must clear 136.00, or 135.00 beckons.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE need a clear break above the 136.00 resistance to keep away from the ominous 135.00 which otherwise beckons, technical analysts said on Friday.
Below 136.00 the market faces the prospect of losing its foothold around 135.00, incurring sharp losses.
"Keep in mind the dangers of a close under 135 and a break of the head and shoulders neckline through 134.50," said analysts at a European bank in a research note.
But with Italian markets closed to mark Assumption Day, BTPs were likely to be confined to a narrow range, traders said.
By 0840 GMT, September BTP future was 0.18 down at 135.38.
The daily chart has a potential head and shoulders formation, with the neckline around coming 134.50. A break of this level will send the market sharply lower.
Analysts at an Italian bank in London said a support trendline crossed the market at 135.21 while resistance trendline came in at 135.76.
"It's necessary to break one of the two levels in order to get a clearer direction," they said in a research note.
Chase analysts said 135.10 support was under pressure while BTPs were below 135.79. Sept Eurolira was 0.01 down at 93.21.
